name: Necromancer
description: The Necromancer is a highly experimental government project. It is equipped with three A-75 Missile Repeaters. The weapon is mounted on top of your ship's power cells. Using the E=MC2 principle it converts your ship's power to Consolidated Arms Mk. 83 guided missiles.
